_comment: Per-page differentiation for build-nation-pages.py (added 2026-09-19 after 37/38 titles and H2 skeletons were found to be identical templates). title: short hook for <title>; howto: the How-to-Write H2; uses: the occasions H2; image: second line drawn in the page's PNG (must use characters the Everly font has — no macrons/carons). `explore` (optional) replaces the page's Explore paragraph — used by the six kept pages after the hub and 31 sibling pages were retired on 2026-09-19.
